prompt: A flat, low-contrast frame from a fixed wide lens bolted into the corner where the attic wall meets the sloping ceiling, looking across a tiny kitchenette shelf: Brandon stands beside a dented sink with a plastic shaker bottle tipped against his mouth, head back, brows lifted, eyelids heavy, eyes aimed at the ceiling.
